ranked.headline: Models couple histology and spatial omics to resolve tissue heterogeneity
ranked.summary: Foundation models and multimodal frameworks now infer spatial pathway activity and cell niches directly from histology and spatial profiles.

ranked.headline: Metabolite signatures and multi-omics data mapped to gene-level and association units
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply metabolic models, double machine learning, and graph networks to link microbes, metabolites, and genes.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and correction methods for single-cell and spatial omics analysis
ranked.summary: Method papers now target batch effects, replicate design, spatial QC and cell-type resolution across single-cell and spatial datasets.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics machine learning models predict cancer drug and chemotherapy response
ranked.summary: Attention-based fusion, graph embeddings and foundation models are being applied to predict drug and regimen response from multi-omics and clinical data.

ranked.headline: Augmentation and cheap embeddings address scarce-label sequence classification
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers test generative augmentation and training-free embeddings against large pretrained sequence models.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models expose lineage-specific and promiscuous bacterial metabolism
Molecular prediction studies now test uncertainty and reliability, not just accuracy
ranked.summary: Hybrid uncertainty quantification, conformal selection, and PBPK propagation studies now evaluate prediction reliability in molecular modeling.

ranked.headline: Generative models pursue synthesizability and guidance in molecule and protein design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study add synthesis constraints, 3D geometry, and test-time scaling to generative chemistry and protein models.

ranked.headline: ML models link omics features to predicted therapy response in cancer and endometriosis
ranked.summary: Recent work applies single-cell, spatial and multi-omics data to forecast drug and checkpoint response at the patient and cell-subpopulation level.

ranked.headline: Single-cell data map genetic regulation, cell communication and disease-linked cell types
ranked.summary: Single-cell resolution now enables cell-type-specific eQTL, communication and risk-cell inference from large atlases and healthy tissue references.

ranked.headline: Annotation-light deep learning for cell segmentation, classification and profiling
ranked.summary: Current work replaces hand-annotated ground truth with synthetic, self-supervised, unsupervised, and foundation-model training for cell imaging.

ranked.headline: Simulated ground truth defines accuracy limits of sequencing analysis tools
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published 86-tool benchmark use simulated ground truth to quantify tool accuracy limits and optimal settings.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools standardize omics annotation, benchmarking and interval operations
ranked.summary: Recurring genomic and proteomic operations are being packaged into reusable open-source software with defined data structures and interfaces.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and reference spectra for untargeted mass spectrometry data analysis
ranked.summary: Untargeted MS workflows depend on peak detection, statistical choices and spectral references, now benchmarked against established tools.

ranked.headline: Controlled tests ask whether pretrained biomolecular encoders beat simpler baselines
ranked.summary: Recent controlled studies find task-specific encoding and simple masking can match or exceed pretrained biomolecular representations.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence language models applied to RNA, promoter and protein site prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks eleven pretrained genomic language models and tests cross-species and cross-dataset generalization of new sequence models.

ranked.headline: Frameworks quantify transcriptional, regulatory, and spatial features in tissues
ranked.summary: Single-cell, long-read, and spatialomics datasets increasingly require shared, quantitative analysis tools that can be benchmarked and compared across studies.

ranked.headline: Structure predictors benchmarked on disordered, amyloid, designed, and nanobody complexes
ranked.summary: Current structure predictors are being tested beyond well-characterized folds, where reliability for disordered, amyloid, and designed proteins varies.

ranked.headline: Formal and adaptive methods for batch correction and spatial transcriptomics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report guaranteed-optimal batch correction and foundation models for spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Genome assemblies tie size and structural variation to transposition and population size
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies across brown algae, flatworms, termites, amniotes and scrub-jays now resolve architectural change mechanistically.

ranked.headline: Indexing, compression, and sketching structures for pangenome and sequencing data
ranked.summary: Pangenome, ancient DNA, and long-read workflows require indexes that handle damage, graph paths, and large k-mer sets efficiently.

ranked.headline: Variant calls refined via population frequency, read patterns and ACMG criteria
ranked.summary: Short- and long-read variant calls now face population, guideline and allelic-pattern filters that shape individual variant decisions.

ranked.headline: Learned representations encode gene regulatory structure in single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair scRNA-seq and spatial data with graph models and LLM agents for regulon, network, and cell-type inference.

ranked.headline: Learned energy models and enhanced sampling target protein conformational landscapes
ranked.summary: Learned energy models and enhanced sampling shift protein modeling toward conformational ensembles and free-energy landscapes.

ranked.headline: Automated enhanced-sampling methods now target GPCR activation and drug residence times
ranked.summary: Transferable, automated enhanced-sampling protocols now yield absolute activation free energies and residence times across multiple targets.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks assess perturbation models for generalization and biological transportability
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test whether perturbation models generalize and whether in vitro gene effects transport to human in vivo phenotypes.

ranked.headline: Modeling dependency structure among genetic, molecular and environmental variables
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale data now allow testing epistasis, gene co-expression and gene-environment interaction effects on complex traits and methylation directly.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-aware tools for imputation, heritability, haploblocks and crossover estimation
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale haplotype panels and ancestral recombination graphs are being used to make mixed-model and imputation analyses computationally scalable.

ranked.headline: Hierarchical k-mer sketching standardizes bacterial strain classification
ranked.summary: BacTaxID introduces configurable, ANI-proportional whole-genome k-mer clustering as a standardized basis for bacterial classification.

ranked.headline: Transformer, factor and cell-type methods extend GWAS discovery in complex traits
ranked.summary: Recent reports pair GWAS with transformer models, pleiotropy factors, cell-type burden and per-gene evidence packets to refine trait association.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics pipelines prioritize neoantigens and predict pHLA off-target risk
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication pair sequencing, HLA and proteome data with neoantigen ranking and off-target risk scoring for immunotherapy.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained simulations reveal DEAD-box helicase and chromatin folding mechanisms
ranked.summary: Reduced-resolution models now reach unwinding, disordered-tail, and chromosome-folding states that atomistic sampling struggles to access.

ranked.headline: Structure-level graph and atom tracking of metabolites and biochemical reactions
ranked.summary: Recent items formalize atom provenance, stereochemical identity, assembly complexity, and terpene reaction mechanisms at the molecular-graph level.

ranked.headline: Network geometry and behavioral feedback reshape epidemic threshold and stability
ranked.summary: Non-well-mixed contact structure and behavioral coupling each alter threshold and stability conditions in these recent preprints.

ranked.headline: Data-driven models probe nonlinear fitness landscapes and population dynamics
ranked.summary: Interpretability and structure-learning tools are now applied to population genetic and fitness-landscape data, testing what learned models actually represent.

ranked.headline: RBP binding at exon flanks links exon inclusion to histone marks
ranked.summary: Classifiers on RBP binding at exon flanks nominate TIA1 and U2AF2 as candidate episplicing factors, linking splicing to chromatin marks.

ranked.headline: Long reads resolve centromere, telomere and chromatin structure in repetitive genome…
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing now profiles centromeres, telomeres and chromatin contacts in repetitive regions across populations and tissues.

ranked.headline: Computational mapping of protein localization and secretory pathway mechanisms in omics…
ranked.summary: Spatial proteomics and secretory pathway reconstructions now link per-protein localization prediction to pathway-scale mechanisms in antibody production.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve side-chain flexibility and residue-level binding forces
ranked.summary: Docking with full side-chain flexibility and AI-based decomposition of binding contributions move structure analysis beyond static poses.

ranked.headline: Omics embedding tools couple exploration with contrastive text and phenotype alignment
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published framework now standardize autoencoder and contrastive training for omics embeddings, alongside interactive inspection tools.
